reviews.text: They operated on a guinea pig. They were kind, everything went smoothly.
They are kind and helpful.
Everyone is very nice. Fantastic team. We need more honest teams like this. Thank you, I can come to you! :)

We brought a 2 year old (senior) dwarf hamster here with a mouth tumor, which they removed in 15 minutes. Fair price, nice communication, and professional attitude.

We also brought a dog here for vaccinations. The doctor was extremely thorough and kind, and informed me about everything! Compared to other places, Focus Vet is a 5 star!

A great little team works here, everyone is very nice and cute! I took our bunny to them for neutering, I am completely satisfied with everything! I recommend it to everyone from the bottom of my heart!

Professional care, kind attitude, continuous information.
I can only recommend it! 🐰❤️ …

We are new residents in the district, I came to the clinic based on a recommendation. I have never received so much attention and care with my cat. Everyone is really nice and precise! I am glad we went here!

After my guinea pig's bladder surgery, they didn't remove the tourniquet from the branule in time, I removed it on the 2nd day after the surgery, after I asked if I could. The piglet's leg died because of this. On May 1st, I desperately took it to another on-call hospital, where I had to say goodbye to the poor piglet. I think that they were not honest with me many times at Focusvet, I am unspeakably disappointed.
They are kind and conscientious, I wouldn't take my bunnies anywhere else!

Kind and knowledgeable staff, helpful vets.
Good atmosphere and great accessibility, free parking on the street. I recommend this place.
The doctors and assistants were very kind and sweet, they took very professional care of my bunny, I received a lot of valuable information, I recommend it to everyone from the bottom of my heart!!
High level of professional expertise, dear nurses. Honest, detailed information.

I've been here a few times with both of my dogs and have seen two different vets.  Both of the vets were so kind and caring towards both of my dogs, who are elderly and a bit anxious.  They spoke to the dogs on their level and patted them gently before starting the actual exam. The vets are thorough, knowledgeable, and very good communicators.  I feel like I know what's going on and that my pets are in good hands.

The people working there are very nice and sweet, it seems like a professional place. We came here for nothing, we weren't logged in and they welcomed us / kindly helped us!
However, we have to talk about the pricing, we went to our "old" regular vet for the same thing afterwards and we paid less than a third of the amount here and got about the same.
Thank you very much!❤️🐰 …
We always take our rabbits here. Competent doctors, with kind colleagues.
Their veterinarian, Dr. Ágoston Holl, is arrogant and condescending.
They continue to be very professional and helpful doctors and vets, we always bring our rabbits here and thank the Focus Vet team for their care and attention!

I spent a total of 140000 ft. And nothing changed. My cat is still the same as before he left the house. I recently took my cat to this vet and had a very disappointing experience. My cat has been unwell, so we went in for a check-up that cost 42000ft. Unfortunately, despite the high cost, they did not provide any real help for my cat. After an X-ray, they told me to visit another hospital because they couldn’t treat my cat there. This meant I had to pay for another round of check-up fees at a different place, wasting both my time and money. I do not recommend this hospital to anyone. It was a frustrating and costly experience with no resolution for my pet’s health.
Very kind and prepared team, they provided professional information and were even patient. We took a sick Dzungarian dwarf hamster to be treated. 🙂 …

this is a great clinic, i knew we made the right decision when the vet spent a minute petting our cat to calm him

excellent service in english as well!
They took excellent care of our pets! English speakers which was a big plus for us. I highly recommend!
We have been coming here for years and the staff there are always very knowledgeable and helpful.

I had a negative experience here. My dog received the wrong rabies vaccine – I expected the 3-year version commonly used in Europe, but they likely gave the 1-year version on purpose, even though I clearly asked for the longer-lasting one – even if in Hungary it’s typically given annually. Communication was poor overall.
I was also forced to buy a deworming tablet, which I’ve never experienced at any other vet. Usually, it’s up to the owner to decide, especially if the dog has already been dewormed recently. I find it inappropriate to pressure clients into treatments that aren’t necessary at that time.

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend them to anyone. We were very deceived, they did not follow medical ethics, they are driven by personal revenge, especially the manager. During an intervention, they caused serious injury to our bunny, denied it, mistreated it, and then after they found out that we had obtained the real information from somewhere else, they were even more offended and refused further professional care. Unfortunately, our bunny died indirectly due to the unprofessional care they caused. Our souls were broken when we "lost a family member". I do not recommend it to anyone who would go to work here, because the Clinic is facing various investigations in the future.
Trusting in the professional, legal and fair measures of the authorities, the place will be closed as soon as possible so that this does not happen to anyone else, and the 3 responsible persons will be locked up for a good few years for the actions they have committed.

We came to the clinic with our dwarf rabbit in serious, life-threatening condition, which had been treated here several times before. One day before the scheduled appointment, they confirmed by phone that they would accept Bobek. However, we then received an email outside of opening hours, at night, that they would not treat him after all – without any professional or substantive justification.

The next day, we showed up at the clinic in person, hoping that we would still receive help due to the animal’s life-threatening condition. At that time, the managing director announced that they would not accept us because the treating veterinarian “gets a stomach ache just hearing our name”. We were at a loss because the doctor had called the night before to say that we could take Bobek.

This decision was not only seriously unethical, but also directly endangered the animal’s life. For a clinic to refuse to treat an animal in urgent, critical condition based on personal sympathy is completely unacceptable in a veterinary practice. We do not wish to persuade or dissuade anyone from visiting the clinic, but we believe it is important that others know what to expect in a similar situation.

Today we had to use the hospitality of FocusVet with our bunny Fifi, we were completely satisfied in every aspect even 4 years ago during the neutering, this has not changed after today, in fact.. We thank you very much, they do their work with maximum empathy and competence, you can feel their love for animals 100%, they are thorough and answer all questions clearly! ❤️🐰
We can only say good things. All our four-legged family members are/were in good hands here with them.

Compared to our previous experiences, this clinic is of an exceptionally high standard. The staff is extremely knowledgeable, kind and flexible. Although they are a considerable distance from us, we will continue to come here.

We would like to thank them for their thorough work! We only go here after we have already been to three other exos doctors with our bunnies, and only Focus Vet was able to help them properly. Unfortunately, we lost a bunny, partly due to mistreatment by other doctors. However, with a similar disease, we managed to cure one of its companions in time thanks to Focus Vet. They are very knowledgeable, thorough, and experienced in all bunny diseases. Focus Vet is the only place to go with bunnies!
High quality care, helpful and patient.

This place is a rip-off. We arrived on a weekend in January and they didn't charge us extra, I booked an appointment again and now they charged us extra. On top of that, I had to wait 3/4 hours both times. We won't be coming again.

We have been taking our bunnies to Focus-Vet for years. They have saved them from serious illnesses several times. They are a reliable, enthusiastic team who treat with all their heart and soul. They always care about the owners, keep them informed about everything, and are available. Professionally, they are one of the best in the country.
We have been to several doctors in the past 5 years, and Focus-Vet's service was the best of all. I can only recommend them, especially Dr. Ágoston Holl, as an exotic veterinarian.
Nice cooperative workers, accurate on appointments, arrive on time and you'll not wait, price wise not different from other clinics, definitely recommend.
We bought food for our lovely rabbit. Besides health-related issues, it's fantastic that they offer healthy food. We're so glad you exist...
The best bunny place I've ever been to. We love Dr. Ágoston very much. We were also spayed and everything went smoothly with him. He is the guardian of our furry child's health!
The best veterinary clinic, I recommend it to everyone :)
I am extremely grateful to Dr. Beatrix Kovács and her lovely assistant who treated my cat with the utmost dedication and kindness today.

I have been here with several animals and they have always been helpful in everything, both the Doctors and the assistants! They are also empathetic and very kind!
For us, they are the best clinic!🐱🐰

As first time bunny owners, we are 100% satisfied with everything. Our male bunny was recently neutered at the clinic. We received very professional information before the procedure, both over the phone and on site. Everyone was very kind and attentive to us and our pet! :)

Everyone should avoid them. A high school of deception. We went with my 4-month-old puppy for a rabies vaccination. However, they did not find the chip in it (which of course, our regular doctor later found out that it was in there, where it should be), but they “willingly offered” to do an X-ray for 18,000 HUF, put a new chip in it for 15,000 HUF, plus if all of this is there, they will vaccinate it for 11,000 HUF. I said sorry, but I was not prepared to spend that much money at the moment. (especially since the chip is in it, they just “accidentally” didn’t find it). Thanks, then another time, somewhere else. They said no problem, it would be 15,000 HUF. I paid 15,000 HUF simply because we were there and they both pulled the chip finder on the dog. Nothing else happened. They didn’t even examine it. I paid, but wherever possible I will say that they are scammers, everyone should be careful with them!

Awesome vets and techs!! Always the nicest and most understanding, love the animals and take good care of them. I cannot recommend them enough, I only had good experiences with them. Good communication, they speak English too.

They are the guardians of the health of our three furry children! I am infinitely grateful, thank you very much for what you have already done for us, dear reception, dear doctors, everyone lives their profession.
Thank you for being there for us! ❤️
My two bunnies owe their lives to the team (both assistants and doctors), and a special thank you for the humane approach!
